replies.author: Ogrey
replies.body: In terms of looks, the map kills. I absolutely love the way vines appear to creep down the hills and how trees hold that mesozoic style to them. Moving on with gameplay... I'm not sure whether this'd work out or not. Looking at the bare map, it's a pretty small area. Now, cluttering it up with trees galore may not be the best plan of action there. Fortunately, the gap between both tall mountain-thingies is adequate enough for it to be actually paid any attention without players instantly losing interest in taking that route thus recurring to the ever-famous skybridges to dive in the enemy base and shatter the monument. I'm curious to see how this would play out, but I do strongly suggest to increase the map's width a bit more. Just in case.

replies.author: Xuph
replies.body:
the map aesthetics and idea are both really nice. i think putting the monument on top will create a need for skybridges so id guess you could do that. also if you make the map a lot fatter, deeper and longer this could do really good as a tnt map imo. 

if you dont wish to make this tnt map unfortunately you could leave the upper part the same, switch the spawn and monument location and make spawn in that hole in the mountain but a little bit far deep in the mountain and then it would create a pretty interesting gameplay. could also do a portal from spawn to the upper part.

tl;dr: make the map lot bigger (especially the bottom part) and switch monument and spawn locations.
